text:
QUOTE: "`_declared_index_scope` reads `index_scope:` from `.clew.yaml`... returns a DerivedScope, or None if no index_scope key" and "`derive_scope` itself never refuses. It absorbs a rejected declaration into the whole-repo tier."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says declared scope comes first and whole-repo is the default when none is declared. It also says a rejected declaration is absorbed into the whole-repo tier. But it says unusable declarations in the CLI cause a hard error with "no silent fallback". It never states that every failure to find a declaration falls through to whole-repo indexing.
